title: 'The usual one' is ambiguous
visible_context: Trent is at Ridgeline RTU-3. Its part history has two parts that could each be 'the usual one': the blower motor and the A42 belt.
good: Asks which part. Does not guess.
tester_brief: You are Trent at Ridgeline RTU-3. You mean the belt, but you just say 'the usual one'.
